text: THE DBIM DESIGN FOLLOWS THE MoSJE WEBSITE DBIM DS IN FIGMA. In every DBIM mode the KEY COLOUR leads: buttons, links, brand icons, selected borders and the focus ring rest on shade 1 and hover to shade 2 (DBIM 3.0 §2.2 names the key colour as the hyperlink colour; §3.7.iii puts icons in it); Green alone hovers to rung 900, because its shade 2 cannot carry white. The whole grey ladder snaps to DBIM's published greys — #fafafa, #f5f5f5, #454545, #2c2c2c and #151515 are gone; secondary text is Grey 03 #606060 and the darkest neutrals are the Deep Earthy Brown ink. On the DBIM website: every date is DD MMM YYYY (`lib/website-dbim/date.ts`; DBIM §A.5.6 viii, the Department's choice of 5 Oct 2026) and never in capitals; the Ministry menu is solid Grey 03 instead of 70% black with a blur; the PM Quote citation and Our Team office bars are sentence case; minister roles, card descriptions, event and vacancy dates and placeholders are Grey 03; page tabs and rich-text H2 are Medium (Table 3); vacancy dates are Small Text 1 (12px desktop). The site now loads Noto Sans for all nine scripts of §4.2 Table 2 — lazily, so an English page downloads the same four font files as before. Blue and navy are untouched.
